question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Anita is an employee who has unconditional ________ for her company.
solution:
The correct answer is: **love**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• **Support**: To agree with or approve of someone or something. (समर्थन)
 
• **Dedication**: The quality of being dedicated or committed to a task or purpose. (समर्पण)
 
• **Attachment**: Affection, fondness, or sympathy for someone or something. (ममता)
 
• **Love**: A deep and tender feeling of affection for or attachment or devotion to a person or for something. (प्यार)
 
 
 
• In this sentence, the word "**unconditional**" only ties with the word "**love**."
 
• "**Unconditional love**" means showing love for something or a person without considering how it will benefit you or what you will get in return.
 
• From here, it is clear that the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is "**love**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

**Complete sentence:** *Anita is an employee who has unconditional love __for her company.*
